desc:
# Agent Python Tools

- repo: roboflow/supervision
- repo_uri: https://github.com/roboflow/supervision

## File: roboflow_supervision/examples/compact_mask/benchmark.py

Prompts

```
['run the CompactMask benchmark suite that compares dense and compact mask performance across multiple scenarios', 'run a single benchmark scenario with specified objects, resolution, fill fraction, and polygon vertex count', 'summarize benchmark results as a rich console table showing memory ratios and per-operation speedups', 'save benchmark results to a CSV file with scenario metadata, memory footprints, and speedup columns', 'create synthetic detection data with random polygon masks given object count, image dimensions, and fill fraction']
```

Usage

```
{'run_benchmark_main': 'run the CompactMask benchmark suite that compares dense and compact mask performance across multiple scenarios', 'run_scenario_benchmark': 'run a single benchmark scenario with specified objects, resolution, fill fraction, and polygon vertex count', 'summarize_benchmark_results': 'summarize benchmark results as a rich console table showing memory ratios and per-operation speedups', 'save_results_csv': 'save benchmark results to a CSV file with scenario metadata, memory footprints, and speedup columns', 'create_synthetic_detections': 'create synthetic detection data with random polygon masks given object count, image dimensions, and fill fraction'}
```
